design.name: 冰铳炮手
design.brief: The legion's artillery soldier: a stout heavily padded gunner in a dark-iron cuirass and red sash, a wide-brimmed iron helmet and mask, a big bronze barrel-drum of frost powder strapped to his back with hoses, the drum vent glowing cyan (weak spot); it lobs frost bombs in high arcs over cover. Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four fingers.
design.weapon: a short fat bronze hand cannon (火铳) shouldered and angled upward, a frost bomb bursting from its muzzle
design.style_note: Style target: the enemies of Gunfire Reborn — a readable military unit roster where every troop type is told apart at 30 m by silhouette and weapon. Strongly stylized, chunky and exaggerated: big helmets and pauldrons, oversized hands and weapons, compact sturdy bodies, faces hidden behind iron masks with two glowing cyan eye slits, bold saturated colour blocks (lacquer red, dark iron, bronze, white fur, cyan glow), clean bevelled forms, armour plates as a few big shapes, no tiny detail noise. Menacing and cool, not cute.
